en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a thatched-roof pavilion surrounded by trees and palm trees, with people walking and sitting around an open square. At the center stands a tall, slender monument or column. The printed caption at the top refers to the Exposition Coloniale Internationale held in Paris, and the bottom caption identifies this as the pavilion of the French establishments in Oceania, along with the architects' names.
